lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters is visible on the lateral flank. The clusters are arranged in approximately horizontal rows with inter-blob spacing of 1.5 to 2.5 diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of white blobs to create a grid-like anchor node pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least one prominent horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a distinct vertical intensity gradient where pixels are lighter on the dorsal side and transition to shadow on the ventral side of the ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct, elongated organisms (remoras) are attached to and trailing from the posterior edge of the pectoral fin, representing unique temporal markers.
